title: Labour for the town
Pay with your back
summary: You are wanted in {settlement}. {giver} will take labour in place of the fine: haul {count} × {item} for the town's works.
offer: The court will take work in place of coin from those who have none. Haul {count} × {item} to the town's works, and I will see your name struck from the roll.
progress: The pile is not big enough yet.
complete: That is a fair day's labour. Your name is struck from the roll, as far as I can see to it.
